Mira H.: Quick follow-up from the PM — I want to lock owners for remediation items on the recurring cache/eviction failure. I'll drop the items; please claim or call out blockers.

Jon P.: Got it, posting now.

Mira H.: Item A: Add eviction-rate telemetry + deploy-aware alert (Jira INFR-6419). Due 7 days. Acceptance: dashboard, alert with deploy window filter, runbook link.

Jon P.: I'll take INFR-6419. Plan: Grafana panel + alert that suppresses for tagged deploys. Target 2024-05-15.

Mira H.: Item B: Throttle + jitter for background cleanup jobs (INFR-6420). Due 14 days. Feature-flagged rollout.

Sasha V.: I can own INFR-6420. Will add `max_concurrency`, jitter, and a staged rollout.

Mira H.: Item C: Runbook update + oncall checklist linking A/B (RUN-78). Due 5 days.

Rohit D.: I'll draft RUN-78 and include quick mitigation commands.

Mira H.: Item D: Safety rollback automation for config changes on latency regressions (PM-345). Need RACI.

Sasha V.: Proposed RACI: Sasha (R), Mira (A), Jon (C), Rohit (I). I can implement hook wiring.

Mira H.: Ops-bot reminder: follow-up sync in one week 10:00 UTC. Owners should have PR links and verification plan (small load spec) by then.

ops-bot: Reminder set: Postmortem follow-up — 2024-05-16 10:00 UTC.

Jon P.: Quick ask: please group these under a parent ticket for recurring-pattern tracking.

Mira H.: Creating parent INFR-6500 now — link child tickets when you're ready.

Sasha V.: Linked INFR-6420 -> INFR-6500.

Jon P.: Linked INFR-6419.

Rohit D.: RUN-78 linked and small checklist pasted into the ticket:
```
- Check eviction dashboard
- If >5% sustained for 10m: `jobsctl throttle --group=cleanup --pct=50`
- If tail latency >2s for 5m after throttle: trigger rollback
- Escalate to platform oncall if unresolved after 15m
```

Mira H.: Excellent. Reminder: each ticket needs owner, due date, PR/branch, and a verification plan. Flag blockers early. :thumbsup:
